text: KEEP, do not tighten. structure 84.2 RANGE, mp STRONG/DECELERATING is a normal reaction in an intact trend, which I hold through (C8); a red bar and an elder_5d dip are not my danger signal (elder is advisory on my card). The ONE trigger beside ADD-on-pivot_high: a one-day reaction of 1x atr 7.22 off the day's high, exit on sight (C7, my atr translation), or a BEARISH_CHOCH (C20). Until it prints, KEEP; adds only on a daily close above pivot_high (C6).
